newsitem.title: USA: 3-D Geophysical sees break-even Q4. [CORRECTED 17:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: 3-D Geophysical sees break-even Q4. [CORRECTED 17:05 GMT]

text.p: 3-D Geophysical Inc said on Tuesday that it expects to report a breakeven fourth quarter, which is below Wall Street's expectations.

3-D Geophysical was expected to report earnings of $0.08 a share (corrects from $0.21 a share) for the quarter, based on a First Call consensus estimate of three analysts that follow the company. In 1995's fourth quarter, the company reported earnings per share of $0.08.

3-D Geophysical said lower than anticipated margins in the company's Mexican operations, increased costs due to weather conditions and a delay in the startup of a seismic survey in Alaska have hurt its fourth quarter results.
Also, Atlantic Richfield Co has informed the company that it has delayed a seismic exploration contract in Peru for an indeterminate time, 3-D Geophysical said.
As of December 31, 1996, the company had approimately $800,000 of unrecovered costs relating to this contract and it may be required to take a reserve related to the costs, 3-D Geophysical said.
3-D Geophysical said that its backlog at December 31, 1996 for work expected to be completed in 1997 totals $46 million, with $20 million of the figure related to work to be performed in Alaska.
